blocks.title: Tele Medicine Platform — reference flow in production
blocks.note: The flow is linear on purpose: every hop owns its latency budget and failure policy, and a regression in one stage is a cohort, never an estate-wide surprise.

blocks.x: The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Tele Medicine Platform — Industry Use Cases capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)
Baseline measured and signed, the metric and owner named, the risk envelope agreed in writing.
Prove (6-10 weeks)
The pilot runs on real data with a control group — the gate review happens whether the news is good or not.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)
Hardening, enablement and scale-out in that order — no rollout faster than the evidence.
Compound (ongoing)
The next decisions enter the same loop — the backlog ranked by measured value per week of effort.

blocks.x: Told by the operator: the runbooks they actually open, the overrides they still make, and the evidence trail that ended the arguments about whose number was right.

Integration for Tele Medicine Platform — Industry Use Cases follows one rule: the system of record stays authoritative. Decisions and analytics read from it; nothing writes back without a reviewable path.
